commits.message:
feat(spam,blocklist,taxonomy): sender blocklist, spam flagging, and a review queue for new skills

Scoped from the user's ask for a 5,000-email/day-ready system: dedup
already existed and holds up fine (exact-content hash lookup); spam/
blocklist and taxonomy auto-growth did not exist at all. Per the
user's explicit decisions on each: spam is flag-only (nothing is ever
auto-deleted, a human confirms in the frontend), a block is silent and
immediate (blocked mail never becomes a draft), and new taxonomy terms
go into a review queue rather than being added automatically.

Sender blocklist (app/email_parsing/blocklist.py): a domain or exact
email a human has decided to stop hearing from. Checked at the very
top of process_channel_intake (app/channels/service.py), before the
idempotency-key write or any dedupe bookkeeping -- a match is logged
to intake_log with status='blocked' and the function returns
immediately, so blocking actually shrinks the review queue instead of
just tagging entries in it. An exact-email block wins over a same-
domain block, since it's the narrower rule. New endpoints: GET/POST
/blocklist, DELETE /blocklist/{id}, and a one-click POST /drafts/
{id}/block-sender that blocks whichever sender a given draft came
from.

Spam heuristic (app/email_parsing/spam.py): deterministic and
deliberately conservative -- near-empty content, or two-plus marketing-
footer markers ("unsubscribe", "click here to", "limited time offer",
...) together with zero job/hotlist-shaped content. A single
incidental "unsubscribe" line is common on legitimate job-board relays
and is not enough by itself; it's the combination with no real content
that signals bulk mail. A flagged message still becomes a normal,
reviewable draft -- just stamped status='spam' (new DraftStatus value)
instead of the usual draft/needs_review -- with the specific reasons
recorded in metadata.spam_reasons so the reviewer isn't guessing.
Frontend: a "Spam" status filter/badge, a count in the list header,
and a reasons banner on the detail page.

Draft deletion (delete_draft_object in app/drafts/service.py, DELETE
/drafts/{id}): the one genuinely destructive endpoint in this set,
built specifically for the spam-review workflow -- confirm a
status='spam' draft really is junk, then remove it. Refuses a
published draft outright (it may already be live on Core), and
surfaces a clean error instead of a 500 if email_claims/core_pushes
still reference it (both are plain FKs, no cascade, by design).
Frontend gates it behind a confirm() and disables it once a draft is
published.

Taxonomy candidate queue (app/understanding/taxonomy/candidates.py):
scans each posting's own Required/Preferred Skills section (already-
proven extractors from app/understanding/parsers/job_description_
fields.py) for skill-shaped terms the taxonomy doesn't recognize, and
upserts them into taxonomy_candidates -- occurrence_count and
distinct_senders accumulate across separate emails, so a reviewer can
tell "one recruiter's typo" from "this showed up 40 times across 12
domains" at a glance. Never adds anything on its own. Approving
(add_canonical_skill in app/understanding/taxonomy/loader.py) appends
the term to canonical_skills.json on disk and busts every taxonomy
lru_cache in the same call, so it's matchable on the very next email
with no redeploy. New endpoints: GET /taxonomy-candidates, POST
/taxonomy-candidates/{id}/approve, POST /taxonomy-candidates/{id}/
reject. Frontend: a "Blocklist & taxonomy" admin page reachable from
the drafts list.

New tables (app/runtime/db.py, created automatically on next startup
via the existing init_schema() call in app/main.py, no manual
migration): sender_blocklist, taxonomy_candidates.

New coverage: scripts/hermes-900-spam-taxonomy-check.py (14 checks) --
blocklist domain vs. exact-email precedence, a blocked sender never
reaching create_draft_object, spam classification on both a marketing-
only fixture and a real posting with one incidental unsubscribe line
(must NOT be flagged), the spam-flagged draft's actual status/metadata,
delete succeeding and being refused on a published draft, unknown-term
detection, and the full candidate approve/reject round trip including
that approval is live immediately. Full regression suite (17 checks
now) green against a freshly built image and a freshly reset schema.
Frontend type-checks and builds clean (tsc -b && vite build).
